title: Skills Customization Record
description: Machine-readable record of a local delta applied to a non-local skill (ACM-131). One record per skill lives at customizations/<skill>/customization.json. The upstream baseline is never stored in this repo; only the reviewed delta and the baseline_ref it was reviewed against are recorded. Authoritative validation is scripts/customization_check.py.

skill.description: Must equal the record directory name and an inventory skill name.

mode.description: Must equal the inventory skill customization_mode.

baseline_ref.description: Must equal the inventory skill baseline_ref at review time. A mismatch means upstream moved after the delta was reviewed: re-review before applying.

reviewed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the delta review.

retire_when.description: Optional condition under which this customization should be dropped or downgraded.

ops.description: overlay only. Non-empty list of file operations replayed onto an upstream tree by customization_check.py apply. An overlay record takes exactly one of ops or patch.

patch.description: overlay only. Manifest for customizations/<skill>/local.patch, replayed onto a new upstream tree by skill_patch.py rebase. An overlay record takes exactly one of ops or patch.

path.description: wrapper, fork, and local_replacement only. Repo-relative directory containing SKILL.md.

policy.description: policy_exclusion only. The exclusion statement; the inventory skill must also record a compatibility_constraints item with kind policy.

path.description: Path relative to the skill root. No absolute paths, no .. segments, no empty segments, no duplicates across ops.

source.description: add and replace only. Path relative to the record's delta/ directory; must be an existing regular non-symlink file whose sha256 equals sha256.

sha256.description: add and replace only. sha256 of the delta source file.

base_sha256.description: replace and delete only. sha256 of the upstream file the edit was authored against; the hook for ACM-156 patch replay and three-way merge.

sha256.description: sha256 of the sibling local.patch file.

files.description: Every file local.patch touches. Key is a safe relative path; value is the sha256 of the upstream file at baseline_ref, or null when the patch adds the file.
